companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text: Harbor Systems makes software that moves containers through ports faster.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text: Build and run the pipelines that turn vessel and terminal events into reports. You will use Python, Kafka and Spark, and store results in PostgreSQL and ClickHouse.

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text: We offer 30 days of holiday and a learning budget.
